initial.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Install CSM, Guardian, and kernel as one atomic generation
initial.goal: Eliminate mixed Runtime v3 installations by managing CSM, Guardian, and kernel as one verified generation.
initial.required_outcome: One command stages, verifies, activates, and rolls back one matched three-binary Runtime generation through a single atomic current reference.
authority_boundary: Issue #656 and the TBD resilience plan define this slice
One receipt is authority for all three installed artifacts
Generation preflight occurs before service mutation
Local validation does not restart the live Runtime
operator_constraints: Never write tracked files on main
Do not restart the live Runtime
Do not change timeout, provider, identity, Observatory, Caddy, cloud, or Runtime v2 behavior
initial.task_boundary: Implement only atomic matched-generation installation and pre-mutation verification for CSM, Guardian, and kernel.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: One command stages and validates all three binaries
AC-2: One receipt binds revision, platform, profile, Runtime-init schema, and three SHA-256 hashes
AC-3: Activation atomically changes one current reference
AC-4: Prior complete generation remains rollback-capable
AC-5: launchd and Runtime-init resolve the same generation
AC-6: start and reload reject invalid generations before service mutation
AC-7: Negative proof shows rejection leaves service untouched
AC-8: Matched activation and rollback tests pass
AC-9: Excluded Runtime and cloud behavior remains unchanged
AC-10: Focused validation, hygiene, and exact-head review pass
non_goals: Observatory, Caddy, cloud, Runtime v2, or live Runtime changes
initial.plan_summary: Define one generation contract; implement complete staging, verification, activation, and rollback; add pre-mutation CSM checks; prove with focused tests and review.

steps.action: Define generation layout, receipt, compatibility, and verification.
Implement staging, atomic activation, predecessor retention, and rollback.
Add CSM start and reload preflight before service mutation.
Run focused proof and exact-head review.

stop_conditions: Integrity cannot be proven before mutation
Scope widens into a later slice

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove matched staging, receipt integrity, activation, predecessor retention, and rollback after the issue-owned target is implemented.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Issue-owned focused target is created during bounded implementation.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove invalid generations are rejected before service mutation after the issue-owned test target is implemented.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Issue-owned focused target is created during bounded implementation.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed before service mutation on a missing artifact, hash or receipt mismatch, incompatible schema, partial activation, or unverified rollback target.
review_prompts: Can an incomplete set become current?
Does the receipt bind exact activated files?
Is rollback limited to verified generations?
initial.review_scope: Atomic Runtime v3 generation installation, shared receipt, current activation, rollback, and pre-mutation CSM verification only.
